title: refactor(sync): synchronize database records
description: Fetches uncommitted database records and syncs batch to replica.

ground_truth.description: Silent exception suppression: broad except clause discards errors with pass.
ground_truth.explanation: Silently suppressing exceptions prevents error detection, alerting, and data consistency recovery (flake8-bugbear B110).

expected_evidence.description: Do not pass silently in broad exception blocks.
